note: The closed value lists for message metadata, with one-line definitions. Written 2026-09-25 for the answer key and the Jev crunch. Existing value ids are kept (rules and step A use them); new ones are added. A value's family only groups the list in the UI. Edit freely, then run: talos taxonomy load A value with "common": N (1 = first) is also listed in a Common group at the top of the answer key (together with the values you use most).

origin.label: Origin
origin.description: Who or what produced the message. The main split is person vs machine; the machine values say what kind of machine.

values.label: Person
values.description: A human wrote it to you or to a group you are in, directly.

values.label: Person via a system
values.description: A human's own words delivered by a platform: a ticket reply, a LinkedIn or Blocket message, a document comment, a calendar invitation someone sent.

values.label: Mailing list or group
values.description: People writing to a list or group address (Google group, distribution list, forum digest of people's posts).

values.label: Automatic reply
values.description: A machine answering on a person's behalf: out of office, calendar Accepted/Declined, read receipts.

values.label: Transaction
values.description: Caused by something you did or bought: receipt, order, booking, invoice, payment, login code, password reset.

values.label: Notification
values.description: Routine information from a service; nothing of yours is failing: account changes, provider status and service-health notices, new followers, personal account security warnings.

values.label: Alert
values.description: A system you run (monitoring, backup, alarm, your own security tooling) reports a failure, threat or threshold you may have to act on. Provider status pages, service-health notices and security warnings about your personal accounts are notification.

values.label: Scheduled report
values.description: A periodic report or digest from a system: backup summary, usage or cost report, DMARC report, weekly statistics.

values.label: Mail system
values.description: The mail system itself: bounce or delivery failure, quarantine notice, spam digest, mailbox full.

values.label: Marketing
values.description: A company promoting itself: newsletter, offer, campaign, webinar invitation, survey.

values.label: Spam or phishing
values.description: Unsolicited or malicious: phishing, scams, junk you never signed up for.

type.label: Type
type.description: What the message is, whatever its subject.

values.label: Discussion
values.description: A back-and-forth exchange between people, with no single clear ask.

values.label: Question
values.description: Someone asks for information or an opinion.

values.label: Request
values.description: Someone asks for an action, a delivery or an approval.

values.label: For your information
values.description: A person informs you; no reply is expected.

values.label: Introduction
values.description: An introduction, networking or first contact.

values.label: Short reply
values.description: A brief acknowledgement: thanks, ok, received.

values.label: Announcement
values.description: One-to-many information from an organisation or a person: company news, all-staff mail, school or course information.

values.label: Inbound enquiry
values.description: Someone contacts you or the company with an interest: a lead, a web-form request, an interest in renting or buying.

values.label: Application
values.description: Someone applies to you: a job or internship application, a CV, a supplier wanting to be listed.

values.label: Meeting invitation
values.description: A calendar invitation to a meeting or event.

values.label: Calendar response
values.description: Accepted, declined or tentative replies to an invitation.

values.label: Meeting change
values.description: A meeting moved, updated or cancelled.

values.label: Meeting notes
values.description: Minutes, summaries, recordings or action lists after a meeting.

values.label: Reminder
values.description: A reminder of an appointment, a meeting or an event coming up.

values.label: Receipt
values.description: Proof of a purchase or payment already made (kvitto).

values.label: Invoice
values.description: A bill to pay (faktura), or a reminder about one.

values.label: Order confirmation
values.description: An order was placed or changed.

values.label: Delivery
values.description: Shipping, tracking, pickup or return of a package.

values.label: Booking
values.description: Travel, tickets, tables, appointments: a reservation and its changes.

values.label: Subscription
values.description: A plan, renewal, trial ending, price change (elpris, abonnemang) or cancellation.

values.label: Statement
values.description: Bank, card, Klarna, pension or insurance statements and summaries.

values.label: Payment notice
values.description: A payment went through, failed, was refunded or is due.

values.label: Quote or offer
values.description: A vendor's quote, proposal, price list or contract offer to you.

values.label: Sign-in or code
values.description: A login notice, verification code or one-time password.

values.label: Password
values.description: A password reset or change.

values.label: Account change
values.description: Settings changed, a new account, updated terms or privacy policy.

values.label: Account security
values.description: Suspicious activity, a breach notice, a new device on one of your accounts.

values.label: Welcome or sign-up
values.description: A new account, a registration to confirm, a welcome mail, a trial started.

values.label: Terms or privacy update
values.description: Changed terms of use, privacy policy or data handling (personuppgifter).

values.label: Access request
values.description: Someone asks to join your team or get access; an invitation to a workspace.

values.label: Usage or quota
values.description: Storage nearly full, a usage or spending threshold reached, a plan limit.

values.label: Backup report
values.description: A backup job's result, success or failure.

values.label: Monitoring alert
values.description: Uptime, performance, capacity or error alerts from monitoring.

values.label: Security event
values.description: Defender, quarantine, DLP, firewall or identity-protection findings.

values.label: Alarm
values.description: Physical alarms and their resets (the alarm company, burglary, fire).

values.label: Incident or outage
values.description: A provider reports an outage or an incident and its updates.

values.label: Planned maintenance
values.description: Planned changes, maintenance windows, service interruptions ahead.

values.label: Service change
values.description: Product or service changes, release notes, deprecations, retirements.

values.label: Licence or asset
values.description: Licences and licence keys, renewals, end of life, warranties, asset register notices (work or personal software).

values.label: Support ticket
values.description: A support case or ticket and its updates.

values.label: Change notice
values.description: A change request or change notification in someone's process (CRQ, REQ, release announcements to you).

values.label: Development
values.description: GitHub, CI, pull requests, issues, deploys, dependency alerts.

values.label: Report
values.description: Usage, cost, DMARC or activity reports from a system.

values.label: Newsletter
values.description: Recurring editorial reading from an organisation or a person.

values.label: Offer or advert
values.description: An offer or campaign sent to a customer or mailing list: discounts, sales, deals, product launches, webinars with gifts. Mass promotion, even from a vendor you use.

values.label: Event or webinar
values.description: An invitation to a conference, webinar, fair or event (not a meeting).

values.label: Survey
values.description: A feedback request, review request or questionnaire.

values.label: Digest
values.description: A roundup from a platform: LinkedIn, Facebook, forums, news summaries.

values.label: Creator post
values.description: A new post, release or update from a creator or artist you follow (Patreon, Gumroad, Bandcamp).

values.label: Job advert
values.description: Job listings and job alerts, not addressed to you personally.

values.label: Cold sales pitch
values.description: A pitch aimed at you or the company as a new customer, usually asking for a meeting, a demo or a reply ('quick call?', '15 minutes this week?'), from someone you have no deal with.

values.label: Partner or vendor offer
values.description: A vendor or partner you already work with proposes something new: an upsell, a programme, a funded offer.

values.label: New listings alert
values.description: New adverts matching a saved search (Blocket 'Nya annonser', Tradera bevakning).

values.label: Message about an advert
values.description: A buyer or seller writes about an advert (Annonssvar, 'Angående din annons').

values.label: Advert status
values.description: Your advert was received, published, expired, or its statistics.

values.label: Automatic reply
values.description: Out of office or another automatic answer to a mail you sent.

values.label: Mail system notice
values.description: Bounce or delivery failure, quarantine, junk report, mailbox or list membership notice.

values.label: Spam or scam
values.description: Junk you never asked for: scams, phishing, pills, fake prizes, 'personal discount' spam.

values.label: Social activity
values.description: Likes, follows, comments, mentions, friend requests on a platform.

values.label: Shared document
values.description: A file, folder or link shared with you, or a comment on one.

values.label: Signature request
values.description: An e-signature request or a signed document (Scrive, DocuSign).

values.label: Official letter
values.description: From an authority, school, healthcare, bank or insurer (often via Kivra).

values.label: Other notice
values.description: A routine machine notice that fits no type above.

values.label: Other
values.description: Nothing above fits.

topic.label: Topic
topic.description: What the message is about. Personal topics first, then work topics under Work/. Pick the most specific that fits.

values.label: Family
values.description: Family life and relatives, when nothing more specific fits.

values.label: Kids' activities
values.description: The children's sports, clubs, parties and leisure.

values.label: Kids' gaming
values.description: Games, gaming accounts and purchases for the children.

values.label: Groceries
values.description: Food shopping, including Hemköp and grocery deliveries.

values.label: School
values.description: School, preschool and after-school: letters, meetings, reports.

values.label: Home
values.description: The home in general, when nothing more specific fits.

values.label: Housing
values.description: The housing association (BRF), rent or mortgage, repairs, renovation.

values.label: Utilities
values.description: Electricity, broadband, water, waste, heating.

values.label: Car and vehicle
values.description: Car, service, tyres, parking, tolls, vehicle tax.

values.label: Health
values.description: Healthcare, dental, pharmacy, training for health.

values.label: Finance
values.description: Personal finance in general.

values.label: Bank
values.description: Bank accounts, cards, loans.

values.label: Payments and Klarna
values.description: Klarna, Swish, payment services, instalments.

values.label: Insurance
values.description: Insurance policies, claims, renewals.

values.label: Tax
values.description: Skatteverket, tax returns, deductions.

values.label: Savings and pension
values.description: Pension, savings, funds.

values.label: Authorities
values.description: Other authorities: Försäkringskassan, Transportstyrelsen, the municipality, Kivra letters.

values.label: Orders
values.description: Online orders, receipts and deliveries when no better topic fits.

values.label: Shopping
values.description: Stores, products and offers you shop from.

values.label: Marketplace
values.description: Blocket, Tradera, Vendolin, vend.se: buying and selling second hand, adverts.

values.label: Music
values.description: Music software, instruments, gear, licences and services.

values.label: Association
values.description: A music association you are part of, and its activities.

values.label: Travel
values.description: Trips, flights, hotels, itineraries.

values.label: Local transport
values.description: Trains, SL, car sharing, taxis, e-scooters.

values.label: Streaming and media
values.description: Netflix, Spotify, HBO, news subscriptions, podcasts.

values.label: Gaming
values.description: Your own games, platforms and gaming purchases.

values.label: Culture and events
values.description: Concerts, theatre, festivals, tickets for events.

values.label: Sports and training
values.description: Gyms, running, sports clubs, races.

values.label: Food and dining
values.description: Restaurants, recipes, food delivery (not groceries).

values.label: Associations and clubs
values.description: Clubs, non-profits and organisations you are a member of.

values.label: Social networks
values.description: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and similar, as platforms.

values.label: Friends
values.description: Personal contact with friends: plans, photos, catching up.

values.label: Studies and courses
values.description: Your own studies and courses: university, Medborgarskolan, online courses.

values.label: Photography
values.description: Cameras, photo sites and photo services.

values.label: Personal tech and accounts
values.description: Your personal Apple, Google, Microsoft and other consumer tech accounts and devices.

values.label: Jobs and career
values.description: Job offers, recruiters, your employment, career platforms.

values.label: Newsletters (general)
values.description: Reading material with no clear subject above. Prefer the subject (Travel, Music, Shopping…) when there is one.

values.label: IT operations
values.description: Running the company's IT day to day, when nothing more specific fits.

values.label: Backup
values.description: Backup jobs, restores, storage for backups (NAS, Proxmox, M365 backup).

values.label: Monitoring
values.description: Uptime, performance and log monitoring (Pingplotter, Grafana, alerts).

values.label: Security
values.description: Threats, Defender, DLP, phishing, vulnerabilities, security reviews.

values.label: Identity and access
values.description: Entra ID, accounts, MFA, permissions, onboarding and offboarding access.

values.label: Network
values.description: Firewalls, switches, Wi-Fi, DNS, DHCP (Check Point, UniFi).

values.label: Remote access and VPN
values.description: VPN clients, remote access, gateways.

values.label: Microsoft 365
values.description: Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, Intune and M365 admin.

values.label: Cloud
values.description: AWS, Azure and other cloud platforms.

values.label: Development
values.description: GitHub, code, CI, deployments, developer tools.

values.label: AI
values.description: AI tools, agents, models and their use at work.

values.label: Devices and hardware
values.description: Computers, phones, peripherals, purchases and repairs.

values.label: Assets and licences
values.description: Asset register (Snipe-IT), licences, renewals, end of life.

values.label: Costs and invoices
values.description: Supplier invoices, costs, budgets, FinOps of our own spend.

values.label: Expenses to report
values.description: Receipts to report, expense claims (Kvitton att rapportera).

values.label: Vendors and partners
values.description: Suppliers, partners, resellers and their sales contact.

values.label: Customers
values.description: Customer work and customer contact.

values.label: FinOps product
values.description: The FinOps offering and product we build and sell.

values.label: Alarm and office
values.description: The alarm company, the office, keys, premises.

values.label: People and staff
values.description: Colleagues, HR, recruitment, staff augmentation, onboarding.

values.label: Company and internal
values.description: Company news, all-hands, internal information, management.

values.label: Meetings and planning
values.description: Meeting logistics and planning with no clearer subject.

values.label: Learning and events
values.description: Training, certifications, conferences, webinars for work.

values.label: Legal and compliance
values.description: Contracts, DPAs, GDPR, PCI, audits, policies.

values.label: Side quests
values.description: Side projects and workshops outside the core job (GTL workshops and similar).

ask.label: Ask
ask.description: What the message expects of you, or promises you made. Empty when nothing is asked.

values.label: Question to you
values.description: Someone asks you for information or an opinion.

values.label: Action for you
values.description: Someone asks you to do, send or fix something.

values.label: Decision or approval
values.description: Someone needs your decision, approval or signature, or a decision was just made that you must know about (a completed signature on an order form).

values.label: Deadline
values.description: It carries a date by which you must act (a due date, an expiry).

values.label: Your promise
values.description: You promised to do something ("I'll fix it", "jag kollar").

value.label: Value
value.description: How worth keeping and finding again the message is.

values.label: Knowledge
values.description: Explains how or why: an answer, a how-to, specifications, an analysis worth finding again.

values.label: Decision
values.description: Records a decision or an agreement.

values.label: Reference
values.description: Manuals, documentation, product details, price lists, contact details.

values.label: Financial record
values.description: Receipts, invoices, statements: keep for bookkeeping and tax.

values.label: Legal record
values.description: Contracts, signed terms, warranties, official letters.

values.label: Account record
values.description: Account setup, licence keys, serial numbers, subscriptions: handy to find later.

values.label: Memory
values.description: Personal value: family, friends, photos, milestones.

values.label: Context
values.description: Part of a real conversation or decision thread that you may need to follow later; not routine chat.

values.label: Transient
values.description: Read once or not at all, no lasting value: marketing and newsletters you signed up for, codes, delivery updates, routine notices and reports, chat that only moves the day along.

values.label: Noise
values.description: Junk only: spam, scams, phishing and mail you never asked for.

route.label: Route
route.description: Which work category the message belongs to, for finding it from a binder. Top level only. Empty when it is not work, and for automatic replies.

values.label: IT Operations
values.description: Running and maintaining IT: backup, monitoring, servers, Microsoft 365 admin.

values.label: Security
values.description: Security tooling, threats, alarms, compliance, identity protection.

values.label: Costs
values.description: Costs, invoices, licences, subscriptions and vendors' prices.

values.label: Devices & Hardware
values.description: Computers, phones, network hardware, purchases and end of life.

values.label: Admin Toolbox
values.description: Admin tools and routines: scripts, asset register, how-tos for administration.

values.label: Side Quests
values.description: Side projects and workshops outside the core job.

values.label: AI Tooling
values.description: AI tools, agents and models.

values.label: Remote Access
values.description: VPN, remote access and gateways.

values.label: Cloud & Platforms
values.description: AWS, Azure, GitHub and other platforms we run on.

values.label: Network
values.description: Firewalls, switches, Wi-Fi, DNS, DHCP and RADIUS.

values.label: Identity & Access
values.description: Accounts, MFA, permissions, onboarding and offboarding.

values.label: Customers & Business
values.description: Customer work, sales, the FinOps product, business development.

values.label: People & Staff
values.description: Colleagues, HR, recruitment, staff augmentation.

values.label: Company & Internal
values.description: Company news, management, internal routines.

values.label: Learning & Events
values.description: Training, conferences, webinars, certifications.

sender_kind.label: Sender
sender_kind.description: Who produced the message, a human or a machine: the line that is costly to get wrong. Derived from origin.

values.label: People
values.description: A human wrote this (to you or to a group you are in), including a person via a platform (a ticket reply, a LinkedIn or Blocket message, a document comment) and people writing to a list.

values.label: Automated
values.description: A machine or a company system produced it: receipts, notifications, alerts, scheduled reports, marketing, automatic replies, bounces and spam.

sphere.label: Work or personal
sphere.description: Whether the message belongs to your work or to your personal life. Derived from topic: the Work/ topics are work.

values.label: Work
values.description: Your work: IT operations, security, customers, vendors, colleagues, costs, the company.

values.label: Personal
values.description: Your own life: family, home, money, shopping, leisure, travel and your personal accounts.

form.label: Conversation or other
form.description: Whether the message is a conversation with people or something else. Derived from type: the Conversation family is conversation.

values.label: Conversation
values.description: Someone writing to you or with you: a conversation, a question, a request, an FYI, a reply or thanks, an introduction, an announcement, an inquiry or an application.

values.label: Other
values.description: Everything that is not a conversation: calendar mail, money, accounts, operations, reading, selling, marketplace, system mail, documents.

keep.label: Worth keeping
keep.description: Whether the message is worth keeping or short-lived. Derived from value: Keep and find, and Records, are worth keeping.

values.label: Worth keeping
values.description: Worth keeping and finding again: knowledge, decisions, references, and records (financial, legal, account, memories).

values.label: Short-lived
values.description: Useful for a while or not at all: context for something current, transient notices, noise.

kind.label: Kind
kind.description: What the message is to you, in one coarse word: how you read mail, for filters and the mailbox structure. The level above type: every type belongs to one kind (derived_from), and Jev can also be asked it directly.

values.label: Conversation
values.description: People writing with you, and nothing in particular asked: a discussion, a reply or a thank-you, a chat, a message about an advert, a document someone shared or commented on.

values.label: Question or request
values.description: Someone asks you something or asks you to act: a question, a request, an approval or signature, an enquiry or lead, an application, a request for access.

values.label: Invitation
values.description: An invitation to a meeting or appointment you are expected at, or a change to one. Not a mass event invitation: that is an announcement.

values.label: FYI
values.description: Something you may want to know about your own things, no reply needed: a renewal, a resolved ticket, an update to software or a service you use, an account or sign-in notice, a reminder, a person keeping you posted.

values.label: Announcement
values.description: News sent to many, from an organisation or a person: a release or launch, a newsletter or digest, an event or webinar, company or school news, a creator's new post, a survey.

values.label: Alert
values.description: Something may be wrong and needs a look soon: a monitoring alarm, an outage, a security warning, a limit reached.

values.label: Report
values.description: A system's regular account of how things went: backup results, usage, cost or DMARC reports.

values.label: Offer
values.description: Someone wants to sell you something: a campaign or discount, a cold pitch, a partner's proposal, a quote, new adverts or jobs matching a search.

values.label: Transaction
values.description: A purchase or payment in motion: a receipt, an invoice, an order, a delivery, a booking, a payment, a statement.

values.label: Spam
values.description: Junk you never asked for: scams, phishing, fake prizes.

values.label: Other
values.description: None of the above fits.
